description: This file defines Kubernetes API types related to server configuration, including admission control, egress selection, tracing, authentication, and authorization. It contains struct definitions, constants, and interfaces used for configuring and managing various aspects of the Kubernetes API server, with a focus on security, networking, and extensibility.

classes.name: AdmissionConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration for admission controllers in Kubernetes API server.

classes.name: EgressSelection
classes.description: Configuration for a single egress selection client.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: Configuration for connection details used in egress selection.

classes.name: Transport
classes.description: Transport configurations for connecting to konnectivity server.

classes.name: TCPTransport
classes.description: TCP connection details for konnectivity server.

classes.name: UDSTransport
classes.description: Unix Domain Socket connection details for konnectivity server.

classes.name: AnonymousAuthCondition
classes.description: Conditions under which anonymous auth is permitted.

classes.name: Issuer
classes.description: Configuration for an external OIDC provider issuer.

classes.name: ClaimValidationRule
classes.description: Rules for validating claims in JWT tokens.

classes.name: ClaimMappings
classes.description: Mapping of claims to user attributes.

classes.name: PrefixedClaimOrExpression
classes.description: Configuration for a claim or expression with optional prefix.

classes.name: AuthorizerConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration for a specific authorizer, including webhook settings.

methods.description: Type for duration values in metav1 API.
